items.title: National Institute of Nutrition study finds strong link between diet quality and Rheumatoid Arthritis
items.one_liner: An ICMR-NIN study links poor dietary diversity and high inflammatory potential to increased odds of Rheumatoid Arthritis.
items.summary: A case-control study by ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition (ICMR-NIN) in Hyderabad involving 615 adults found that patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) consume less diverse diets with lower micronutrient adequacy and higher inflammatory potential compared to healthy controls. RA patients recorded a median Dietary Inflammatory Index (DII) score of 2.18 versus 0.37 for controls, alongside lower dietary diversity and a median micronutrient adequacy (MPA) of 18.9%. Statistical models showed each unit increase in DII raised RA odds by 17%, while higher dietary diversity and micronutrient adequacy reduced the likelihood of RA. Researchers emphasize the need for long-term intervention studies to determine if dietary improvements can prevent or modify the disease.

items.summary: Researchers have developed a production-centered conceptual framework that compares detection and watermarking techniques across direct visual generation models and LLM-driven code rendering routes. items.title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
items.one_liner: An evaluation of RadOnc-Agent demonstrates how LLMs can orchestrate multi-step radiotherapy workflows across clinical phases with high structural accuracy.
items.summary: Researchers have introduced RadOnc-Agent, an LLM-orchestrated framework designed to formalize radiotherapy into four distinct clinical phases and provide 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. Tested on 2,600 single-function requests, 200 cross-stage scenarios, and 120 workflow instances from de-identified patient records, the model achieved high execution accuracy, including 98.79% in single-function selection. Ablation experiments revealed that removing longitudinal state dropped cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling validation increased mismatched backend dispatch to 95.28%. The findings establish technical feasibility for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy workflows via LLM architecture, though clinical correctness and utility remain unproven.

items.title: Navigating Route Latent Space for Synthesizable Molecular Design
items.one_liner: RouteFlow improves synthesizable molecular design by searching over a continuous route latent space using reward-guided flow matching and cycle-consistency.
items.summary: Goal-directed molecular design struggles with generating molecules that are difficult to synthesize in practice, largely due to inefficient discrete search spaces. To resolve this, researchers propose RouteFlow, a framework that reformulates synthesizable molecular design as a search over a continuous route latent space where every latent maps back to a complete synthesis route. RouteFlow uses reward-guided flow matching as a sampler and implements a cycle-consistency mechanism to prevent fine-tuning from pushing latents off the valid synthesis manifold. Evaluated across 16 Therapeutic Data Commons tasks, RouteFlow demonstrates superior sample efficiency, synthetic accessibility, and retrosynthesis success rates.
key_facts: Tasks evaluated: 16 optimization tasks from Therapeutic Data Commons
items.bottom_line: RouteFlow achieves superior synthesizable molecular discovery by shifting optimization to a continuous synthesis route latent space secured by cycle-consistency.

items.title: Passenger bus, running under recently launched M.P. govt service, gutted in fire; passengers evacuated safely
items.one_liner: An MP government-contracted public transport bus caught fire near Ujjain, but all passengers were safely evacuated.
items.summary: A passenger bus operating under Madhya Pradesh's newly launched Mukhyamarntri Sugam Parivahan Seva caught fire and was gutted near Ujjain. Fortunately, all roughly 40 passengers on board were evacuated safely without injuries before the flames spread. Transport officials reported that the vehicle belonged to a private operator contracted by the state, and preliminary investigations indicate the blaze was caused by a short-circuit rather than a tyre burst. The incident sparked political debate as the opposition Congress party previously questioned the fitness standards and rebranding of older buses utilized in the newly resumed state transport service.
items.bottom_line: A short-circuit caused an MP public transport bus fire, though timely evacuation prevented any casualties amidst ongoing political scrutiny of the fleet.

items.title: Bessent Axing 20-Year Treasury May Send Yields Higher, BNP Warns
items.one_liner: BNP Paribas warns that axing the 20-year U.S. Treasury bond could backfire and drive borrowing costs even higher.
items.summary: BNP Paribas warns that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent should avoid eliminating the 20-year U.S. Treasury bond, arguing that such a move could fail to lower yields and instead trigger higher borrowing costs, reduced liquidity, and backlash from bond vigilantes. The 20-year bond has traded at elevated yields—reaching 5.68%—amid ongoing debates over U.S. debt issuance strategies ahead of the Treasury's quarterly refunding statement. Analysts note that scrapping a major maturity would force other tenors to absorb the excess debt, proving counterproductive unless core fiscal issues like inflation and the budget deficit are directly managed. Furthermore, past expansion of buyback programs has failed to stem rising yields, highlighting the limited impact of supply-side tweaks.
items.bottom_line: Eliminating the 20-year Treasury bond risks provoking bond vigilantes and pushing yields higher without resolving core fiscal deficits.

items.title: Beer on new high: Sales see over 40% increase in first six months of financial year
items.one_liner: Karnataka's new alcohol pricing regime led to a 41% surge in beer sales while IML volume growth remained flat.
items.summary: Beer sales in Karnataka surged by 41.32% during the first six months of the financial year, driven by rate rationalization and the introduction of the Alcohol in Beverage (AIB) excise regime. The AIB regime imposes excise duty based strictly on pure alcohol content, making high-alcohol Indian Made Liquor (IML) more expensive and causing IML sales to grow by only 1.14%. Meanwhile, overall state excise revenue collection increased by 13.39% to reach ₹22,191 crore, with beer revenue climbing to ₹3,377 crore.
items.bottom_line: Karnataka's alcohol-content-based excise policy successfully boosted beer consumption by over 41% and raised total excise revenue to ₹22,191 crore.

items.title: How event contract bundles are boosting volume on prediction markets
items.one_liner: Combo contracts drive prediction market volume growth, though headline figures mask lower cash outlays.
items.summary: Combo event contracts on prediction markets, which require multiple selections to win in a parlay-style format, are driving substantial notional volume growth on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket. During the NFL season, these multi-leg contracts accounted for over 50% of notional volume on Kalshi and nearly 50% on Polymarket U.S. However, because prediction markets record both sides of a trade as $1 of nominal volume while combo contracts involve very small initial cash outlays and high potential payouts, headline volume figures can overstate actual cash inflows compared to traditional sports betting handles.
items.bottom_line: Multi-leg event contracts have dramatically inflated prediction market notional trading volumes while representing a much smaller share of actual capital deployed and transactions.

items.title: Kerala High Court sets aside detention order of Thiruvananthapuram councillor R. Sugathan
items.one_liner: Kerala High Court sets aside the KAAPA preventive detention order against Thiruvananthapuram councillor R. Sugathan.
items.summary: The Kerala High Court on Tuesday set aside the preventive detention order issued by the Thiruvananthapuram Collector against city corporation councillor R. Sugathan under the Kerala Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act of 2007. A Division Bench comprising Justices Anil K. Narendran and S. Murali Krishna ordered his immediate release from the Viyyur Central Prison unless required in other cases, ruling that the detention order lacked proper application of mind. The court found that several documents served to him were illegible and that unexplained administrative delays in considering his representations violated his constitutional rights against arbitrary detention. The detention had been ordered based on seven criminal cases registered at the Vattiyurkavu police station, though final reports had already been filed in six of them.
items.bottom_line: Procedural lapses and illegible arrest documents can successfully invalidate state preventive detention orders under constitutional safeguards.

Businesses need to verify which agent is calling, authenticate the customer it represents, and confirm what that customer has authorized it to do. PACT builds on A2A 1.0 and OAuth to support these interactions. Personal agents identify themselves with signed requests (Trust); customers sign in directly with the business and grant permissions (Consent) without sharing their login credentials with the personal agent. items.title: VoltAgent/official-mcp-servers — A curated directory of 280+ official MCP servers from the companies behind the products. No unofficial forks,
items.summary: The curated directory of official MCP servers. No unofficial forks, no abandoned projects, just servers you can trust. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants connect to external tools and data. An MCP server exposes what a product can do (query a database, create a ticket, send an email), and any MCP client such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor can use it. An MCP server can read your data and act on your behalf, so who built it matters.

items.title: flaviocopes/factorylog — See what your coding agents did for you: a timeline of each day and week on your Mac, and where your time went
items.summary: Factory Log shows what your coding agents did for you: a timeline of each day and each week, and where your time went, project by project. Codex, Cursor or any other agent writes a one-line report when it finishes something, and the report shows up in the app a second later. When agents work across five projects in a day, it's hard to say in the evening what actually happened. Factory Log keeps that record for you, written by the agents themselves, in a plain file on your Mac. It never reads your code, your diffs or your terminal.
